purpose: Validation-only leave-one-domain-out evaluation of channel-count agnostic one-scan Mamba pretraining with train-only AutoCon relations.
research_question: Does AutoCon-plus-reconstruction pretraining improve low-data target adaptation and robustness beyond reconstruction-only pretraining, target-only training, and random initialization?
evidence_boundary: No target test split or held-out metric may be opened. This plan is validation-only and must not be used to select a test release after observing any target test result.

required_before_launch: verify every source and target dataset hash plus source-target exclusion
verify pretraining checkpoint hash and reconstruction-only control identity
verify exact low-data split prefixes and robustness stressor seeds
keep all target test splits closed
create immutable source snapshots and guard GPU temperature and fan

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report every target, fraction, stressor and failed cell; do not pool windows or channels as independent replicates.

promotion_rule: AutoCon-plus-reconstruction is non-inferior to reconstruction-only on at least two leave-one-domain-out targets.
It improves a registered low-data or robustness endpoint over random initialization and reconstruction-only control.
It remains non-inferior to the strongest registered external baseline on target validation.
Single-scan prediction-only latency remains within the registered nonlinear reference budget.
A separately reviewed fresh-seed held-out plan is required before any target test metric is read.
